name: Pyramids of Giza
description: Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure pyramids rise on the Giza plateau beside the Sphinx.

name: Great Sphinx of Giza
description: A limestone sphinx faces east below the pyramids.

name: Karnak Temple
description: A vast temple complex of pylons and hypostyle halls on Luxor’s east bank.

name: Abu Simbel
description: Rock-cut temples of Ramesses II relocated above Lake Nasser.

name: Egyptian Museum
description: Tahrir Square museum of pharaonic antiquities (many pieces also move to the GEM).

name: Nile felucca shores
description: Traditional sailboats cruise the Nile between Upper Egypt temples.

name: White Desert
description: Chalk rock formations in the Western Desert near Farafra.

name: Siwa Oasis
description: Remote oasis of salt lakes, palms and mud-brick ruins near Libya.

name: Alexandria Corniche
description: A Mediterranean seafront promenade past the citadel and libraries.

name: Dahab
description: Red Sea diving town on Sinai’s Gulf of Aqaba coast.

name: Khan el-Khalili
description: Historic bazaar cafés serve tea, grilled meats and sweets.

name: Old Cairo eateries
description: Restaurants near Coptic Cairo and the Amr ibn al-As Mosque area.

name: Luxor souk
description: Evening market streets of spices, juices and simple grills.

name: Aswan souk
description: Nubian and Egyptian produce stalls along the Nile corniche.

name: Alexandria fish restaurants
description: Mediterranean seafood kitchens along the corniche.

name: Ramadan evenings in Cairo
description: Iftar tents, lanterns and late-night streets mark Ramadan nights.
